exposure: Type of congenital heart disease (CHD) predisposing to pulmonary overflow (PO)
cohort: 51 newborns with congenital heart disease (CHD) during their first days of life.
finding: Lung ultrasound (LUS) is a reliable tool for the diagnosis of pulmonary overflow (PO) in newborns with congenital heart disease, showing good correlation with echocardiography and better sensibility than physical examination and chest X-ray.
